name: A Common Thread
thesis: A plum personal folio follows one continuous line through making, coding, teaching, and helping. A bold name sits beside precise looping geometry; generous editorial chapters trace those ideas into real work.
interaction: Move a range control or choose one of four story stops to follow a marker along a true continuous SVG path. Each stop previews a different facet and links to its full chapter. Native range keys provide the keyboard equivalent.
why: Uses the warmth of the purple favorite, a real mechanical interaction, personal writing, and authentic hardware and Hack Club artwork. The One Stone makerspace, VEX shop, Stardance software contributions, and Outpost support make the portrait broader than a printer gallery.
